| [TERM-083](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-083.md) | moral standing: being owed moral consideration directly, for one's own sake, and not only for one's effects on others | The owner's, U12 of the exchange of 2026-10-26. A12 split "moral worth" into this and a sense map ([TERM-081](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-081.md)). A claim of standing names its bearer, the interests or claims in question, the ground of standing and what follows. Used at once by the Chagos case: the displaced are owed consideration whether or not they form one agent. Proposed. | Proposed |

| [TERM-087](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-087.md) v3 | cut, and which sense: a Cartesian cut, Pattee's epistemic cut, or Barad's agential cut, enacted by an apparatus | Three senses of "cut" the exchange of 2026-10-27 used, which A9 §4 said "are not interchangeable concepts". The Cartesian cut is a separation of observer from observed taken as given before any measurement. Pattee's epistemic cut ([LIT-1190](../../../record/literature.d/LIT-1190.md), read in [NOTE-952](../../../record/notes.d/NOTE-952.md)) is the functional separation of symbolic description from the dynamics it measures or controls, and is epistemic, not ontological. Barad's agential cut (read first-hand only in her 2012 essay, LIT-1869; LIT-1653 and LIT-1657 unavailable) is a differentiation enacted within a phenomenon by an apparatus, through which boundaries and properties become determinate. Proposed: the record had no word for them, and they recur in [CLAIM-476](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-476.md). | Proposed |
